name: Resinwell Sample Vial
description: A small sealed specimen vial made from layered bark-composite and Resinheart-cured inner lining, used in place of glass for carrying herbs, spores, powders, oils, or other gathered material. Light, durable, and quiet in a travel kit, it protects fragile samples without relying on brittle glasswork.
narrative_effects: Carries a single small specimen — herbs, spores, powders, oils, fragments — in a sealed, travel-resilient container.
Won't shatter under normal field conditions, where glass would; supports clean sample chain-of-evidence narration.
Standard kit for druidic gatherers, Heartwarden field investigators, and elven herbalists.
